add `compute_storage_layout` benchmark (#2324)

Followup on
https://github.com/NomicFoundation/slang/pull/2294#discussion_r4416745088

Note: this new benchmark measures `compute_storage_layout()` and not
`compute_transient_storage_layout()`, since none of the contracts we
measure have transient variables. My understanding is that the
computation is basically the same. But if they are expected to diverge,
we might want to add a new input project specifically to cover this.
